dedupe_keys.name: transient recording of hydrogen flow within grinhy2 0 electrolyser plant

description: Konstantin Schwarze at Sunfire publishes four linked GrInHy2.0 electrolysis-plant measurement tables. The main deposit gives roughly four hours of hydrogen flow during partial-load operation and transitions to and from hot standby, measured within the plant boundary and at the grid interface. Companion deposits provide AC efficiency with and without compression to approximately ten bar during May 2021–October 2022, plus average degradation rates for eight solid-oxide modules. Initial stacks were exchanged after quality problems, and replacement stacks have different operating-hour ranges. All four February 2023 Excel releases are free under CC BY 4.0 and are explicitly linked in this record. Efficiency uses hydrogen's lower heating value and excludes heat input, so it is not total-energy efficiency. These measurements support electrolysis response, degradation and system-dispatch simulations. Sampling intervals and site geography are not stated. No related catalogue parent explicitly includes the collection. Workbooks were not opened.
